maintainer_comments.text: You cannot put delays like this in the code. it needs to loop on an on_idle call, you can look at other modules for examples
this would go in the cpp file not the header. but as delays are not allowed it should be removed.
I think you need to use a timer for this... busy waits are not very friendly to the rest of the code.

You have to remove the busy waits, they are not allowed in the code for anything over say 1us
It locks up the entire system when you do that, and USB will disconnect. At a minimum you have to call on_idle_loop in the busy wait. But really to do it properly you need to use a timer to get the pulse width correct.
it really is not acceptable to have a loop like this that stops anything from running. ON_IDLE needs to be called at least.
you cannot use wait_us either sorry.
I think the wait_for_empty queue may be the only change, that is now `THECONVEYOR->wait_for_idle()`

The basic issue with soft serial is you cannot use wait_us as it blocks. You also could not use on_idle during a us wait with on_idle as it would not be accurate.
I think you need a timer with interrupt to handle the bit stream accurately without halting the system.

Also you need to see when soft serial getc is called, even with on_idle in it anything calling getc will halt the system as it is a
Waits are not allowed in smoothie as it blocks the entire system for 1 us, if there is a way around this it would be better.
